content.text: The Civil War divides St. Louis families and transforms their lives. Clarence Colfax escapes to the Confederacy, fights at Vicksburg, is captured, and is sent home sick. Virginia nurses him and Judge Whipple, while Stephen Brice serves the Union, rises under Sherman, and saves Clarence. Colonel Carvel loses his fortune, flees South, and later secretly visits St. Louis. Hopper exploits wartime contracts and threatens Virginia, but Stephen protects her. Judge Whipple dies in his office, reconciling with Carvel. Virginia travels with Captain Lige to Washington to seek Lincoln’s pardon for Clarence. Lincoln’s compassion changes her views; he pardons Clarence and brings Virginia and Stephen together. They visit ancestral Annapolis, where they learn of Lincoln’s assassination and reflect on reconciliation, sacrifice, mercy, and national unity.
